subject: words
title: Ea says eh: bread
about: The other face of ea: here it says short e, as in bread and head, the same two letters as the Ea words level where ea says ee, so he has to try it both ways (read is in that level, and lead is left out because it can be said two ways). CKLA Grade 1 does not teach ea at all (it is Grade 2 code), so this is a step-ahead level for late spring, straight after the Ea words level; NC RF.1.4.c (vowel teams) and RF.1.4.b (decoding one-syllable words).
tip: If an ea word sounds wrong, say: try it the other way, like in bread.
